stem: The equation w = 25t represents the amount of water w, in liters, where t is the number of minutes. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 25 in this context?
choices: The tank is filling at a rate of 1/25 liters per minute.
The tank is filling at a rate of 25 liters per minute.
The tank has held a total of 25t liters.
The tank has held a total of 25 liters.
answer_text: The tank is filling at a rate of 25 liters per minute.
explanation: In w = 25t, t is multiplied by 25, so w increases by 25 liters for each minute — a rate of 25 liters per minute.
